name: disaster-recovery
description: Design and implement disaster recovery (DR) plans and procedures to ensure business continuity by defining recovery objectives, failover strategies, backup automation, and recovery procedures for catastrophic failures.
inputs: RTO requirements (Recovery Time Objective - acceptable downtime)
RPO requirements (Recovery Point Objective - acceptable data loss)
data inventory (databases, file storage, object storage)
outputs: disaster recovery plan (RTO/RPO, DR strategy, failover/recovery procedures)
DR architecture (primary site, DR site, data replication, failover mechanisms)
recovery runbooks (failover, recovery, failback, validation procedures)
DR testing plan (test scenarios, frequency, success criteria)
